category: LARP organisation management: the back office a live-action role-play group runs its campaign on. It keeps the game world, the character sheets and the players behind them, encodes the group's own ruleset (abilities, skills with prerequisites, items, conditions and effects) so sheets recompute and illegal builds are refused, awards and spends experience after each event, and runs the events themselves (roster, check-in, printed sheets and GM run sheets). It is not a ticket shop, not a worldbuilding wiki and not a virtual tabletop, although buyers compare it against all three for the parts that overlap. Decided from the code on 2026-09-26 (10 schemas in lib/Settings/larpinq_register.json, 31 manifest pages in src/manifest.json); correct it here if the product means to be something else.
